translations.web: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
translations.bsb: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
